about.description: ZeroLab focuses on motion capture, embodied AI teleoperation, and data acquisition. We provide full-stack solutions, including self-developed, low-cost, high-precision wireless motion capture SiP chips and modules, full-body inertial motion capture systems, teleoperation platforms, and a bipedal robot high-dynamic imitation platform. ZeroLab builds an ecosystem based on mocap and teleoperation technologies, constructing an embodied AI database based on real world data to accelerate the training of embodied AI brains in generalized scenarios.
about.headline: Human motion data for the next generation of embodied AI.
about.title: About Us

items.description: Using inertial full-body motion capture devices to collect human motion data for training humanoid robots is a cutting-edge and highly efficient approach. Unlike traditional camera-based motion capture systems, inertial motion capture devices are not affected by ambient lighting or occlusion, making them ideal for data collection in diverse complex environments. By capturing large volumes of high-quality human motion data, it provides rich training samples for the motion control systems of humanoid robots.
items.title: Humanoid Robot Training

items.description: Film and television production is a traditional market for motion capture. Genres such as sci-fi, fantasy, wuxia, and animation rely heavily on VFX, which in turn depend on motion capture technology. With technological advancements, high-precision inertial and hybrid inertial-optical capture systems have emerged, significantly reducing costs while achieving accuracy comparable to optical systems.
items.title: Virtual Production

items.description: The sports sector can be divided into two markets: professional sports and amateur recreation. In fields such as golf, rowing, fencing, running, and soccer, precise motion capture enables athlete performance evaluation, technique improvement, and comparative analysis against competitors' data.
items.title: Sports

items.description: Motion capture technology enables VR users to experience true immersion and interactivity. Technological advances have also made large-scale multi-user VR interaction, real-field multiplayer VR games, and VR-based virtual instruction possible, forming the foundational technology of the metaverse.
items.title: Gaming & Entertainment

items.description: One major application of motion capture is virtual digital humans. Popular virtual idols and streamers such as A-Soul, Liuyexi, AYAYI, and CodeMiko all rely on motion-capture-driven virtual human technology. Virtual streaming has become the fastest-growing category on Bilibili's live platform.
items.title: Virtual Influencers

items.description: Data captured through motion capture technology can be widely applied in sports and rehabilitation training, providing users with scientifically precise motion guidance.

Each finger is equipped with a 10-bit high-resolution bend sensor and a low-latency integrated inertial orientation module, enabling real-time capture of fine hand motions and converting them into digital signals.

items.description: A humanoid robot typically consists of around 30 motors, making traditional programming approaches insufficient for full-body control. ZeroLab provides complete data acquisition and teleoperation solutions ranging from motion mapping to motion control, helping users accelerate humanoid locomotion, anthropomorphic movement, imitation learning, and zero-shot transfer.

items.description: Mr. Kan Yigong, founder of the Xiaoxiaowuke curriculum system, uses ZeroLab's wireless full-body motion capture suit to collect essence motion data from the Sun-Moon Form of Tai Chi. The ZeroLab Motion Tracker offers exceptional data stability and precision, with built-in advanced spatial position correction algorithms for accurate joint position tracking. It features quick wear, a snug fit, and up to 8 hours of standby, enabling motion data capture anytime, anywhere without venue limitations.
items.title: Tai Chi Expert Uses ZeroLab Full-Body MoCap for Cultural Heritage Data Collection

items.description: ZeroLab Data Gloves are interactive gloves based on MEMS inertial sensor motion capture technology for hand motion digitization. They recognize finger movements in real time, delivering precise five-finger motion in virtual interactions. Users enjoy an immersive experience, freely exploring virtual spaces with full presence.
items.title: ZeroLab Data Gloves Interactive Experience

items.description: An OpenArm-based optimized motion capture upper-limb robot developed by a ZeroLab customer, enabling a low-cost, ultra-low-latency remote teleoperation solution. This system can be widely applied in various teleoperation scenarios and data acquisition tasks, providing efficient solutions for industrial automation and robot control. #AI #HumanoidRobot #MotionCapture #Teleoperation #OpenArm #ZeroLab
items.title: OpenArmZ MoCap Teleoperation Upper-Limb Robot

items.description: Through ZeroLab's motion capture system, a human operator controls the Unitree humanoid robot in real time, allowing the robot to perfectly replicate human movements — achieving a shadowing effect. Every subtle movement of the operator is captured with precision and transmitted to the robot in real time, demonstrating the ultimate human-robot interaction experience. #AI #HumanoidRobot #MotionCapture #Teleoperation #Shadowing #ZeroLab
items.title: Shadowing - Real-Time Human Control of the Unitree Humanoid Robot

items.description: In complex environments, ZeroLab's motion capture system still accurately captures operator movements and controls the Unitree humanoid robot in real time to complete various complex tasks. Whether fine hand motions or full-body coordination, the robot flawlessly replicates them — truly achieving a human-machine integrated control experience.
items.title: Shadowing 2 - Humanoid Robot Teleoperation in Complex Scenarios

items.description: By the end of 2024, ZeroLab MoCap achieved an integrated solution bridging robotic arm and dexterous hand remapping and teleoperation. This enables coordinated control of robotic arms and dexterous hands — users can collect motion data from both in real time through the MoCap system and transmit it for synchronized operation.
items.title: ZeroLab MoCap Integrated Solution with Realman Robotic Arm & Ohand Dexterous Hand
